name: Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling, Inc.
old_description: Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling was founded in 2009 with the aspiration to become the Premier plastic injection molding supplier in the Southeast.  The owners of Premier Plastic, Scott Dittman and Phillip Sparks, came together bringing their combined experiences in injection molding to form a plastic manufacturing company with a focus on quality and service.  We are always committed to promoting our outstanding reputation by treating our customers with integrity and excellence.
about:
Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling, Inc. was founded in 2009 in Winder, Georgia, just northeast of Atlanta. The company was formed by Scott Dittman and Phillip Sparks, who combined their experience in injection molding to establish a plastic manufacturing business focused on quality and service.

The shop specializes in custom injection molding, tooling, and product development, offering prototyping assistance to help entrepreneurs and inventors move from concept to production. It also runs stocking programs designed to keep molded parts available on demand and emphasizes quick turnaround on orders.

The company serves entrepreneurs, inventors, and other customers across the Southeast seeking a local source for custom-molded plastic components. It works with clients regardless of order volume, providing personalized service from prototype through full-scale manufacturing.

The founders' stated aspiration was to become the premier injection molding supplier in the Southeast, differentiating through integrity, excellence, and an American-owned, operated model that prioritizes direct customer relationships.
